controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Top-level policy set that gives management direction for how the org handles information security.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Who owns what — defined and allocated security accountability across the org.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: No single person can both execute and approve a sensitive action unchecked.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Leadership must actively support and enforce security policy, not just sign off on it.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: A defined channel for engaging law enforcement/regulators when needed.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Staying plugged into security forums/associations for early threat awareness.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Actively gathering and acting on information about emerging threats.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Security is built into projects from kickoff, not bolted on at the end.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: A maintained register of what information/assets exist and who owns them.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for how staff may use company information and assets.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Process to reclaim company assets/access on termination or role change.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Labeling information by sensitivity so protection matches risk.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: Applying classification labels consistently across formats.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Rules for securely moving information within and outside the org.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules governing who can access what, based on business need.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: Managing the full lifecycle of digital identities.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Protecting passwords/credentials and how they're issued and reset.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Granting, reviewing and revoking access rights in line with policy.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Managing security risk introduced by suppliers/vendors.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Baking security clauses into supplier contracts.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Extending security expectations down the technology supply chain.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Ongoing oversight of supplier security performance, not a one-time check.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Security requirements specific to acquiring/using/managing cloud services.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Having a defined plan before an incident happens, not during one.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Deciding which events qualify as an incident requiring response.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: The actual response process once an incident is confirmed.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Feeding incident learnings back into controls to reduce recurrence.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: Preserving evidence properly for potential legal/disciplinary action.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: Maintaining an acceptable security level during a business disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: Ensuring IT systems can support the org's continuity plans.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Identifying and meeting all applicable external obligations.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Protecting IP and respecting others' IP rights.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Keeping records accurate, accessible and protected per retention needs.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: Handling personally identifiable information per privacy obligations.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: Periodic review of the ISMS by someone outside the team being reviewed.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Verifying that staff/systems actually follow the stated policies.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures are written down and kept current, not tribal knowledge.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification of candidates before hiring, proportionate to role risk.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: Security responsibilities are stated in employment contracts.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Ongoing training so staff actually understand their security responsibilities.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: A formal, communicated process for handling security policy violations.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Security duties (e.g. confidentiality) that survive employment ending.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Formal agreements protecting sensitive information.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Security measures specific to staff working outside the office.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: A clear, easy channel for staff to report suspected security events.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Defined physical boundaries protecting areas holding sensitive assets.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Controls on who can physically enter secure areas.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical protection tailored to each facility's sensitivity.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Continuous monitoring (e.g. CCTV, alarms) of physical premises.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Safeguards against fire, flood, power loss and similar hazards.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Additional rules for anyone working inside a designated secure area.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Reducing exposure of sensitive info left visible/unattended.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Placing and protecting equipment to reduce risk of damage/unauthorized access.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Protecting devices/assets taken outside the office.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Managing storage media securely across its lifecycle.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Protecting power/utilities that equipment depends on.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Protecting power and data cabling from interception or damage.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Maintaining equipment correctly to preserve its security properties.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Ensuring data can't be recovered from decommissioned equipment.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Protecting laptops/phones/other endpoints that hold or access information.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: Extra controls around accounts with elevated system access.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Restricting access to information per the access control policy.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Controlling who can view/modify source code.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Authentication mechanisms strong enough for the risk involved.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: Monitoring/planning resource capacity to avoid failures under load.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Defenses against malicious software.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Identifying and remediating vulnerabilities in a timely way.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Managing secure configurations and detecting unauthorized drift.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Deleting information when it's no longer needed, per policy.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Obscuring sensitive data (e.g. in test environments) to reduce exposure.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Controls to stop sensitive data leaving the org improperly.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Regular backups to enable recovery after loss/corruption.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Enough redundancy to meet availability requirements.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Recording events to support detection, investigation and audit.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Actively watching systems/networks for anomalous behaviour.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: Synchronized system clocks so logs across systems can be correlated.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: Restricting powerful utilities that could bypass normal controls.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Controlling what software can be installed on live systems.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.description: Protecting networks and the information flowing across them.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Ensuring security features of network services are identified and used.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Separating networks/network segments to limit blast radius.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Managing access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for when and how cryptography is used to protect information.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.description: Security built into every phase of software development.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Security requirements defined and validated for applications.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Security principles applied when designing/building systems.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Coding practices that avoid introducing security vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Testing for security issues before systems go live.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: Security oversight of development work done by third parties.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Keeping environments separate to protect production from untested changes.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Controlled process for making changes to systems to avoid unintended impact.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Protecting/handling test data appropriately, especially if derived from real data.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Minimizing disruption/risk when audits test live systems.
